candidate_workaround: Separate lexical scanner candidates from confirmed payload hits with exact semantic dispositions, and preserve a bounded sanitized failing-test tail before rerunning the unchanged scoped gates.
failure_signature: The first scoped evidence validation marked a semantic browser-diversity field as a private callable and reported one test error without retaining the traceback in its compact receipt.
recurrence_guard: A regex match is a candidate, not a confirmed payload; record an exact disposition and retain enough sanitized test output to diagnose every scoped failure.
rollback: Give the failed 25-check validation zero pass credit, preserve its receipt, and do not weaken or delete any scanner class or test.
scope_boundary: Same-owner v646-v8 scanner adjudication and scoped-test diagnostics only; not complete privacy, accessibility, security, or independent-reproduction assurance.
title: Adjudicate scanner candidates and retain scoped-test diagnostics
trigger_preconditions: a five-class scan reports a lexical candidate
a compact test receipt reports a failure without a diagnostic tail
